method.package: Local npm pack from exact Publisher source commit; archive digest checked.
method.installation: Empty HOME and npm configuration; npm install --offline --ignore-scripts into a private consumer.
method.execution: Installed public CLI, empty PATH and NODE_PATH, exact Build Request digest, no source checkout inside consumer.
method.relocation: Copy installed consumer, remove original, rebuild both Editions and compare every Candidate member digest.
method.directComparison: Build both Editions with the same source commit and selected AIGW bytes; compare every member digest.
